meta_description:
Every story has an ”Everafter”
Sometimes it’s happy, sometimes it’s heartbreaking, sometimes it feels like magic, and sometimes it takes you somewhere you never expected.

We never really know what The Everafter will be until we get there.

This one is very special. 
Naal Naal Ve audio releases very soon and the whole EP comes out this October. - 96K likes, 3,255 comments - @darshanravaldz on September 24, 2026
